Home.title: Data Scientist & Consultant
Home.bio: With a Master's degree from the University of Tokyo, I now work at Mitsubishi Research Institute, where I focus on data science and AI consulting in the financial sector — solving complex business challenges with data and generative AI. Before that, I delivered Salesforce-based digital transformation consulting and implementation at Deloitte. Outside of work, I build quirky side projects and travel across all 47 prefectures of Japan and beyond, documenting my journey through the lens of my camera.

fukushima-jul-2026.title: Fukushima: The Memorial Museum and the Disaster Ruins

photos.1: Fukushima · Futaba — inside the Great East Japan Earthquake and Nuclear Disaster Memorial Museum, hand-drawn koinobori streamers hang in a row: a fish covered in cherry blossoms, and the words 'fall seven times, rise eight.'
photos.2: Fukushima · Futaba — the sign that once stood in Futaba, 'Nuclear power: a prosperous society and town,' is now preserved at the memorial museum.
photos.3: Fukushima · Futaba — the air dose rate display in front of the museum reads 0.05 microsieverts per hour.
photos.4: Fukushima · Namie — a classroom at Ukedo Elementary School, preserved as a disaster ruin: desks and rubble as they were left, light falling through the broken ceiling. On that day, every pupil and teacher at the school evacuated safely.
photos.5: Fukushima — marigolds in full bloom in a roadside flower bed, a stretch of orange and yellow.
photos.6: Fukushima · Miharu — a bottle of Miharu Shuzo's junmai ginjo 'Aihime,' bought locally; a profile with cherry blossoms on the label, and a soft, clean taste.
photos.7: Fukushima · Kitakata — Kitakata ramen: slices of chashu covering a clear soup, chewy noodles, a mellow flavour.

autumn-dec-2025.title: Autumn Collection: Lake Ashi, Showa Kinen Park, and Hitachi Seaside Park

photos.2: Kanagawa · Hakone — a small boat crosses Lake Ashi as a flock of waterbirds skims the surface.
photos.3: Kanagawa · Hakone — the pirate ship heads for the pier at sunset, clouds glowing orange-red.

photos.5: Tokyo · Tachikawa — susuki plumes shine in the setting sun, each one lit through.

photos.12: Ibaraki · Hitachinaka — from the park's hill: reddening kochia and the little red train in front, the sea in the distance.

photos.3: Saitama · Kawagoe — a row of lanterns hangs along a corridor at Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine, each lit panel bearing a chrysanthemum crest.
photos.4: Saitama · Kawagoe — on the Yamato Takeru float, a dancer in a white fox mask turns around beside the festival drums.
photos.5: Saitama · Kawagoe — a gourd lamp glows by the street, carved with the silhouettes of three snowmen.

MiniGame.title: Mousse Dash
MiniGame.howTo:
📖 A data storm scattered the homepage's data! Charge up with Mousse for 45 seconds and gather it all back.
🎮 Drag her (or use the arrow keys) to move:
• Golden motes +30 pts (important data)
• Plain motes +10 pts
• Ink blobs −20 pts — steer clear
• Purple viruses: −1 life on contact
• Brick walls are solid: hit one from below and it stops you and carries you down — slip through the gaps
• Pushed off the screen: −1 life too
💪 3 lives. The farther you run and the more you gather, the higher the score!

profile.intro: This page is Zeli's profile — his education and career history, all in one place.
feel: Deloitte to Mitsubishi Research Institute — a steady path. I rather admire it.
A master's from the University of Tokyo; he's this thorough about everything.

feel: All built after work, bit by bit. Quality aside, the effort is genuine.
The games you play with me live in the games corner now — stop by there when you're done here.

guestbook.intro: This is the guestbook — visitors leave a few words here. You're welcome to add yours.
guide: Leaving a message is easy — just a name and a few words; he reads every one.

room.intro: This is Mousse's room — where you earn stars and buy her furniture. She lives here.
guide: Check in daily for stars and a snack; when you've saved enough, the shop below sells her furniture.
She walks over and uses what you buy: reaching for books, writing at her desk, reading on the rug.
Her status shows when she's hungry, tired or bored — snacks, play and rest all help.

games.intro: Welcome to the games corner! Every game here is one you play together with me.
guide: The top card is the 45-second dash game — tap it and we'll play a round together. Score 300 in one run to unlock my sportswear.
The bottom card is the prefecture quiz: guess where Zeli's travel photos were taken, and correct answers earn stamps on your map.
From any other page, drag me onto the bubble at the top of the screen and let go — it brings you straight here. I'll be waiting back where I was.
At the bottom is my little room — earn stars and buy me furniture there. Come visit often.

garden.intro: This is Mousse's indoor garden — you came in through the flower stand in her room. Planting, watering, blooming: everything here takes its time.
guide: Tap a pot to water it — once a day moves it one day forward, and it blooms on day ten.
Harvesting blooms earns stars, and six lifetime harvests unlock her gardener outfit.
Flowers never wilt here; missing a day just pauses them, so no pressure.

discovery.general1: A tiny ladybug landed on the windowsill. She counted its spots.
discovery.general2: She turned the cup on the desk around, saying it looks better this way.
discovery.general3: Today's clouds look like cotton candy. She stared out the window for a long while.
discovery.general4: She drew a star in her notebook and said it was saved for you.
discovery.shelf1: The top-shelf book needed full tiptoes — she nearly wobbled off balance.
discovery.desk1: She wrote half a page of diary at the desk. It starts with “Another fine day today.”
discovery.rug1: The rug is so soft she nearly dozed off mid-chapter.
discovery.plant1: The plant grew a tiny bit taller. She measured it against her hand.
discovery.hungry1: Her tummy just growled. She pretended it was a bird outside.
discovery.happy1: She's in an especially good mood today — little skips in her steps.
discovery.close1: She says this room feels more like a home because you visit.
discovery.close2: She saved half of her favourite snack, saying you'd share it when you came.
discovery.secret1: Little discovery: I have a small habit — when I find a sentence I love, I secretly write it down, and read it again on low days.
discovery.secret2: Little discovery: I think I really like rainy days. The pattering outside makes time feel slower.
discovery.secret3: Little discovery: a secret — when I eat snacks, I always look at the prettiest piece first... then I cannot bear to eat it.
discovery.secret4: Little discovery: sometimes I space out staring at pots that have not bloomed yet. Nothing is happening, yet they feel like they are quietly trying.
discovery.secret5: Little discovery: if we wrote down every little thing each day, would this room slowly become a thick storybook?
discovery.secret6: Little discovery: honestly, I have gotten used to the sound of you opening the door. On days I do not hear it, something feels missing.

rules: Check in daily: +10 stars and a snack, plus your streak count.
Stars buy furniture. It appears in the room and she'll walk over and use it herself.
Fullness, mood and energy drift down over time; snacks, play and rest refill them. They never hit zero — she just gets needy.
Intimacy grows with check-ins, care and time together, and never drops. Each level brings a new title and something new.
